name: ZSC-Eval
description: ZSC-Eval is the first evaluation toolkit and benchmark for zero-shot coordination (ZSC) in multi-agent reinforcement learning. It generates evaluation partner candidates, selects partners by Best-Response Diversity, and measures generalization performance using the Best-Response Proximity metric.
reputation: A recent research benchmark/toolkit from the multi-agent RL literature, but not yet a widely standardized community benchmark.
notes: Includes human experiments to verify consistency with human evaluation; benchmark covers Overcooked and Google Research Football environments.
